candidate.title: `cilium_identity_label_sources` is a new metric which counts the number of identities with per label source
candidate.text: `cilium_identity_label_sources` is a new metric which counts the number of identities with per label source. This is particularly useful to further break down the source of local identities by having separate metrics for `fqdn` and `cidr` labels.

evidence.excerpt:
* `cilium_identity_label_sources` is a new metric which counts the number of
  identities with per label source. This is particularly useful to further break
  down the source of local identities by having separate metrics for `fqdn`
  and `cidr` labels.
